title: FlowOps trusted peer workflow correction

tests.name: Full regression
tests.conditions: 149 passed in 34.01 seconds on isolated flowops_test. Operator opt-in, profile revocation, streaming error bounds, frozen contracts, legacy and canonical workflows. One pre-existing Starlette deprecation warning.

tests.name: Real peer workflow
tests.conditions: Persisted native FlowOps API/worker and fresh PostgreSQL, real pinned private KnowledgeOps/AgentOps APIs, fresh synthetic-only credentials. Positive citation lookup, preserved AgentOps POLICY_BLOCKED, restart and operator approval. Owned temporary services stopped; their data retained.

tests.name: Static and pin checks
tests.command: uv run ruff check flowops tests scripts operations migrations && uv run mypy flowops
tests.conditions: Ruff/mypy/whitespace passed; all 81 frozen contract hashes match. Dependency lock and export are unchanged from the earlier audited revision.

costs.method: Synthetic run reported zero provider usage. Isolated AgentOps database contained zero admitted runs and attempts; its policy refusal occurred before provider execution. Hosting/development cost is excluded.

limits: Local operator-authorized workflow only. Public v0.1.0 and the initial port 8766 adapter were not changed. No production cutover.
KnowledgeOps positive edge is limited to the authorized synthetic search-guide fixture on pinned 172a6c9; supplemental citations cannot authorize business actions.
AgentOps 50bb507 still refuses the HIGH-risk EUR eu-test context-bearing order review. Refusal and typed deterministic fallback are verified; successful inference is not.
Default workflows remain peer-disabled. Per-run private operator header and matching file-based profile are required.
ResolveAI outbound event delivery, production credentials, frontend/proxy integration, journal archival and sustained capacity tests remain outside this correction.
No new deployment image, independent security certification or real customer corpus was tested. Rehearsal ran native local Python services and a pinned PostgreSQL container.
